verdict.rationale: Folk documents its own bulk capabilities. Batch API endpoints act on up to 100 records per request, the enrichment endpoint handles up to 500 people at once, and the official MCP server has a help article on updating many records at once, which suits AI-native users. Missing for 10: detail on which operations (create/update/delete) the batch endpoints cover, depth beyond a title for the MCP bulk-update use case, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Batch endpoints let you act on up to **100 records** in a single request.
Request an enrichment of up to 500 people with Enrich people.
Update many records at once with folk MCP
